info.name: ReqRes API - Automation Suite
info.description:
End-to-end API test suite for the public ReqRes demo API (https://reqres.in).

Covers users CRUD, resource listing, and auth (register/login) with 42 requests across 8 folders.

Design highlights:
- Baseline assertions (response time, JSON content-type) run at the collection level for every request.
- Request chaining via collection variables (listUserId, createdUserId, authToken).
- Real JSON-schema validation with tv4 (bundled in the Postman sandbox).
- Positive, negative and edge-case coverage per resource.

Run order matters for the chaining requests: execute the whole collection top-to-bottom (Newman does this by default). Chained requests also self-heal with sensible fallbacks so each request stays runnable in isolation.

Note: the demo write endpoints (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /api/users) echo the payload and do not persist data.
